4 احصد It (seed-produce) attained to the proper time for its being reaped; as also ↓ استحصد : (S, Mgh, Msb, K:) or the latter, (assumed tropical:) it. invited the act of reaping. (TA.) ＝
-A2- He twisted a rope (S, K) firmly. (TA.) ―
-b2- [He made firm, in a general sense. (Golius as from the KL; but not in my copy of that work.)]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
